items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 July 2026 10:06pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 18 July 2026 at 10:05pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind in places at first and again late in the period.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, with ridges to the Norwegian Sea and across Ireland to Britain.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first around the North Channel and near the southwest of the Isle of Man, then veering and decreasing East or Northeast 2 to 4 in all waters later in night or at first tomorrow morning. Backing North or Northwest 3 or 4 later in afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5 occasionally 6 in the west.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later tonight, becoming slight or moderate Sunday evening.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 from the North Channel to near the west of the Isle of Man.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
